name: Scan Bed
summary: A drop zone that scans your file with a laser, reads its real details and SHA-256, then uploads it
about: Scan Bed is a dark glass drop zone with a green laser. Drop or choose any file and the corner brackets close in, the file lands on the glass and the laser sweeps it while the read-out types in what the browser really finds: name, type, size, date, image size or line and word counts, and a SHA-256 fingerprint. Then bytes float up as it uploads and a MATCH stamp slams down when the server copy checks out.
how: Drop a file on the bed, press Choose a file, or Try a sample (a CSV or a picture made on the spot).
Watch the laser sweep while the facts and the SHA-256 fingerprint type in; text files show their first lines, other files their first bytes.
The upload bar fills with floating hex bytes, then the MATCH stamp lands and every row turns green.
Copy the fingerprint, or press Scan another to clear the bed.
